snippet.title: World of Tanks Blitz Reforged Update: Join the First Ultra Test!
snippet.description:
World of Tanks Blitz Reforged Update is coming—and it’s MASSIVE! Jump to https://reforged.wotblitz.com to join the first open test.

Unreal Engine 5 visuals, redesigned player progression, tanks grouped into sets, enhanced physics, all-new Commanders, and so much more. Blitz is being reborn, blending fresh features with the battles you love.

Your progress? Safe. 

Join the test right now and share your thoughts and impressions! Better hurry though—spots are limited! 

The test kicks off on January 24. We'll see you there.
